title: The Salt of Ashvale
author: V. M. Kavanagh
blurb: Emrys Delacroix, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
